title: US Consumers Report an Estimated $17 Billion Spending at Small Businesses on 14th Annual Small Business Saturday This Year

facts.fact: According to American Express's 2023 Saturday Consumer Insights Survey, the projected total spending of U.S. consumers who shopped at independent retailers and restaurants on Small Business Saturday 2023 reached an estimated $17 billion.
facts.quote: the total reported projected spending of U.S. consumers who shopped at independent retailers and restaurants on Small Business Saturday, which took place on November 25 this year, reached an estimated $17 billion.

facts.fact: According to American Express, total reported spending at small businesses during Small Business Saturday in the U.S. has reached an estimated $201 billion since the day was created in 2010.
facts.quote: total reported spend at small businesses during the annual Small Business Saturday in the U.S. has reached an estimated $201 billion2 since the day was created in 2010.
Since it launched in 2010, Small Business Saturday has brought communities together

facts.fact: Small Business Saturday 2023 took place on November 25 in the U.S.
facts.quote: which took place on November 25 this year

facts.fact: This was the 14th annual Small Business Saturday, according to the page title.
facts.quote: on 14th Annual Small Business Saturday This Year

facts.fact: American Express set a goal to reach $100 billion in spending by consumers at small, independently owned retailers or restaurants on Small Business Saturday and during other Shop Small campaigns from 2021 through 2025.
facts.quote: our goal to reach $100 billion in spending by consumers at small, independently owned retailers or restaurants on Small Business Saturday and during other Shop Small campaigns from 2021 through 2025

facts.fact: Small Business Saturday in the U.K. was scheduled to begin on December 2 (2023).
facts.quote: Small Business Saturday in the U.K. will begin on December 2.

facts.fact: The 2022 Small Business Economic Impact Study cited by American Express found that if every Gen Z and Millennial shopper spent $10 at a small business on Small Business Saturday, it would support $2 billion in local economic activity throughout the U.S.
facts.quote: if every Gen Z and Millennial shopper spent $10 at a small business on Small Business Saturday, it would support $2 billion in local economic activity throughout the U.S.

facts.fact: The 2022 Small Business Economic Impact Study cited by American Express found that $0.68 of every dollar spent at a small business in the U.S. stays in the local community.
facts.quote: $0.68 of every dollar spent at a small business in the U.S. stays in the local community

facts.fact: The 2022 Small Business Economic Impact Study cited by American Express found that every dollar spent at small businesses creates an additional $0.48 in local business activity.
facts.quote: every dollar spent at small businesses creates an additional $0.48 in local business activity

facts.fact: The American Express 2023 Saturday Consumer Insights Survey reported that 59% of U.S. consumers aware of Small Business Saturday shopped or ate at a small, independently owned retailer or restaurant on Small Business Saturday 2023.
facts.quote: 59% of U.S. consumers aware of Small Business Saturday shopped or ate at a small, independently owned retailer or restaurant on Small Business Saturday this year.
